Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Media Cabinet, 47"W, Gray
Colors: Grey
The shelving and pullout drawer in this sleek, modern media cabinet offer plenty of storage space for electronic and multimedia components. The strong lines and metal legs produce a contemporary flair, while the patterned panels add that touch of elegance every home needs. 47"W x 16"D x 16"H Engineered wood with metal legs This modern media console makes a wonderful accent piece in any home. The shelving and 1 pull drawer make this media cabinet great for storage. Assemble in 15-30 minutes Wipe clean with a dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
